en: A black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a rural settlement with scattered houses and farm buildings in a valley, fenced meadows, leafless trees, and forested hills leading up to snow‑covered mountains in the background. Printed German text at the bottom identifies the place as Ober-Schreiberhau in the Riesengebirge and the specific settlement as Siedlung Leiterweg.
